name: Personalized Sticky Note Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood, durable and eco-friendly with a smooth finish.
    - All parts are crafted from 3mm thick wood, ensuring a lightweight yet sturdy structure.
    - Box back: Available in a 2-layer or 3-layer (each layer 3mm thick) design for added depth and personalization.
    - Box structure (front, sides, base): Single-layer wood panels.
    - Precision-cut pieces fit together securely for a clean and polished look.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 3.5 x 3.5 x 6 inches ~ 8.89 x 8.89 x 15.24 cm.
    - Inner storage size: 3.27 x 3.27 inches ~ 8.31 x 8.31 cm.
    - Fits standard sticky notes up to 3 x 3 inches ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports double-sided printing for the box front, sides, base and layer 1 of the box back.
    - Single- sided printing for layer 2 and layer 3 of the box front.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a desktop sticky note holder for easy access and organization.
    - Keeps your workspace neat while adding a personalized decorative touch.
    - Easy to assemble with interlocking wooden pieces (no tools required).
    - Lightweight, compact, and suitable for desks, offices, or study spaces.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for teachers, students, coworkers, or office staff.
    - Ideal for back to school, teacher appreciation, birthdays, or holidays.
    - Personalized name design makes it a unique and meaningful gift.
    - A practical yet stylish addition to any workspace. 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 xPersonalized Sticky Note Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
